Generated TypeScript type for Marble model. Seed data structure must match this type.

package.name: tsx
package.note: Required for TypeScript seed script execution

interface.name: Marble Prisma Model
interface.signature: prisma.marble.create({ data: { slug, name, description, density, basePricePerCm3, origin, textureFolder, finishes: { create: [...] } } })

interface.name: MarbleFinish Prisma Model
interface.signature: finishes: { create: [{ type: FinishType, priceModifier: number }] }

interface.name: MANUFACTURING_CONSTRAINTS
interface.signature: export const MANUFACTURING_CONSTRAINTS = { MIN_DIMENSION: 5, MAX_DIMENSION: 100 } as const

constraints.constraint: JSON fields for name/description must contain all 5 locales: en, fr, it, es, de
textureFolder must match slug pattern for /public/textures/{slug}/ asset structure
basePricePerCm3 stored as integer (cents) for precision
Density values typically ~2400-2750 kg/m³ for marble types
Use as const for compile-time type safety on constants
Seed script must be idempotent - use delete-then-create or upsert
Use transaction wrapper for atomicity during seeding
Log progress and result counts for debugging
Use tsx (not ts-node) for faster TypeScript execution
Seed script uses DIRECT_URL (not pooled connection) for local execution

tests.standards: Unit tests verify seed script creates correct marble count with all required fields. Integration tests run seed against test database and query results via Prisma. Test idempotency by running seed twice and asserting same marble count. Use Vitest as test framework per tech-spec.
